title: Go-To-Market Sensitivity Analysis
description: Which GTM channel drives the best CAC payback, and how sensitive is your growth to channel mix?

decision.prompt: Choose your primary GTM channel for the next 6 months.

options.label: Inbound
options.description: Content, SEO, and community-led growth. Slower to build but compound returns and lower CAC over time.

options.label: Outbound Sales
options.description: Direct outreach and SDR-led pipeline. Faster feedback loops, higher CAC, but predictable scaling.

options.label: Product-Led Growth
options.description: Let the product drive acquisition via freemium, trials, and viral loops. Lowest CAC, but requires strong activation.

cac_inbound.label: CAC — Inbound ($)
cac_inbound.description: Customer acquisition cost via inbound channels.

cac_outbound.label: CAC — Outbound ($)
cac_outbound.description: Customer acquisition cost via outbound sales.

cac_plg.label: CAC — PLG ($)
cac_plg.description: Customer acquisition cost via product-led growth.

ltv.label: Customer LTV ($)
ltv.description: Average lifetime value of a customer.

monthly_budget.label: Monthly GTM Budget ($)
monthly_budget.description: Total monthly spend allocated to go-to-market activities.
